poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison_arrow.description: A ranged strike that poisons the closest enemy.

ranger_volley.name: Volley
ranger_volley.description: Fires a wide volley that damages every enemy in range.

healing_draught.name: Healing Draught
healing_draught.description: Restores a portion of maximum HP when the Ranger is wounded.

guardian_shield.name: Aegis Shield
guardian_shield.description: Raises a protective barrier based on maximum HP.

guardian_slam.name: Ground Slam
guardian_slam.description: Smashes the battlefield, damaging every nearby enemy.

blade_storm.name: Blade Storm
blade_storm.description: A rapid area burst that strikes all living enemies.
